title: More nations' most capped players
brief: Name each nation's most capped player in full internationals.

notes.Andrew Robertson: Andy Robertson had 97 caps on 19 July 2026, behind Dalglish's 102.
notes.Andy Robertson: Andy Robertson had 97 caps on 19 July 2026, behind Dalglish's 102.
notes.Jim Leighton: Jim Leighton is behind Dalglish for Scotland.
notes.Chris Gunter: Chris Gunter (109) is second for Wales.
notes.Wayne Hennessey: Wayne Hennessey (109) is second for Wales.
notes.Pat Jennings: Pat Jennings (119) is second for Northern Ireland.
notes.Shay Given: Shay Given (134) is second for Ireland.
notes.Ivan Perisic: Ivan Perisic (158) is second for Croatia.
notes.Luis Suarez: Luis Suarez (143) is behind Godin for Uruguay.
notes.Peter Schmeichel: Peter Schmeichel is behind Eriksen for Denmark.
notes.Simon Kjaer: Simon Kjaer (132) is second for Denmark.

notes.Anders Svensson: Svensson has 148 in the Swedish FA's count (146 in FIFA's).

checks: Each record holder agrees between the nation's Wikipedia infobox and Transfermarkt's record caps page. Sweden: 148 in the Wikipedia infobox and RSSSF, 147 on Transfermarkt, 146 in Wikipedia's 100-cap list; Svensson is the record holder on every count (Ravelli 143). USA: Cobi Jones 164 in Wikipedia and RSSSF (Transfermarkt 163), ahead of Donovan's 157. Modric and Lewandowski counted to 19 July 2026 (202 and 167); they played again later. Scotland: Robertson reached 100 only after 19 July 2026.
